title: Bull Market vs Bear Market: What Do They Mean? (Crypto Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Bull and bear are the two words you hear most in crypto. Here is what they mean in plain English.

scenes.head: BULL OR BEAR?
scenes.narration: You hear bull market and bear market all the time in crypto. What do those words actually mean?

scenes.head: BULL MARKET
scenes.narration: A bull market is a long period when prices keep rising and most people feel optimistic.

scenes.head: BEAR MARKET
scenes.narration: A bear market is the opposite. Prices fall for a long time. Many people use a drop of twenty percent as the rule of thumb.

scenes.head: THE MOOD
scenes.narration: The mood swings too. In bull markets people feel greedy. In bear markets fear takes over. Both feelings can cloud judgment.

scenes.head: NOT A CRYSTAL BALL
scenes.narration: Nobody can say exactly when a cycle starts or ends. Labels like these are usually clear only in hindsight.

scenes.head: WHAT TO REMEMBER
scenes.narration: Remember, no trend lasts forever. Hype is not a plan. The best habit for a beginner is to keep learning.
